  After having seen several promotions on box 8, I thought of giving it a try today for evening snacks due to some attractive offers. This is a delivery only franchise with currently 31 outlets in Bangalore and some more in other Indian cities known for serving boxed meals.

Delivery:
-All the items were cleanly packed without spillage. Loved the colorful box that the sandwich wrap was packed in.

Food:
-Fiery paneer sandwich: This is a sub sandwich made of fresh bread with sauce and veggies in them. Though it was healthy and filling, tasted average.
-Masala lemonade: Tasted tangy and not fresh. I wouldn't recommend this one.
-Jamoon: This is the only item that I loved among the ones that I have had here.
-Salad: not bad

Food: 2/5
Delivery: 3.5/5
QFM: 1.5/5

Edit: reducing the rating as the help desk service is not at all helpful. Neither did I get the cashback nor the discount even after calling the customer care 3-4 times!

  Thanks to Biriyani Nights, I didn't have to go hungry one night, when even after waiting for 1 hour for an order to be delivered by Swiggy, it didn't turn up. Rare for Swiggy, but it happened nevertheless. So, around 11:30 pm, when every other restaurant was closed, it certainly helped that Biriyani Nights delivered not just a great combo item, but delivered it nearly 8 kms away to where the restaurant is located.

The combo included chicken biryani (more than 4 pieces), chicken kebabs, a spiced egg, sweet and a soft drink. The price maybe was a bit high, but considering the amount can easily be shared by 2 persons, it came to around Rs. 200/- per head.

Great service! Thanks to the guy named Naresh who works with a smile..

DESSERT : To top it off, they provided complimentary coke and some soft and YUMMY Gulab Jamun!

  Considering the fact that i just finished my food and immediately began to write down a review simply means that i loved their food. The delivery time is precise and their packaging is commendable. 

Coming to food, I ordered the chicken biryani combo. the biryani was a little towards the saltier side and the rice grains weren't meant for biryani nevertheless the taste was good. The chicken pieces were rightly cooked nothing too dry and had with raita and rasam, it was genuinely good.

The kebabs weren't really kebabs but tandoori chicken and crispy ones at that. therefore naturally they tasted good. 

The bonus factor was their gulab jamun. It was the exact dessert i was on a lookout for. The gulab jamun was uber soft and warm, exactly how it should be served! 

For late night hunger pangs in the ramaiah area, look no further for your perfect meal!

  Box8 has grown into one of the many places that can trust upon with closed eyes. Being an avid foodie who significantly considers the portion size as well, I have been satisfied over my predisposed skepticism time and again. From the wraps to sandwiches to fusion boxes to all-in-one meals, I cannot possibly think of any loophole to initiate a criticism. Consistency may not be for everyone who desire a change of palate often, but it sure works when you don't have time and space for experimentation. The half star is reserved for the future and I would love to give that away. So, what are the odds Box8? Amaze me again!

  Ordered my Saturday Lunch and it was really worth along with awesome Lemonade to digest everything :)  Iced tea was really authentic to start with.

Kadhai Paneer curry was really good and different from other food providers as it was less in oil and spices and good in quantity for 2.  Tawa Paratha was neatly prepared to give you nice taste along with balanced oil..  Basmati Rice smelled the best out of all food and was great in taste too,  

Tried total Veg Tandoori wheat wrap and Paneer Biryani also after that and i loved both,especially the softy Paneer pieces in Biryani . Kulfi pack was really tasty with good packing and Deserts were really mouth watering but my favorite will be Ghee Moong Dal Halwa.  

All in all it was one more great experience with Box8 for authentic north Indian food :)

  I wanted to order food as it was raining and feel like going out. The problem is when you want to order online and customize the dish that you ordered its not possible. Packing is good. Its worth a try.

RATED
  This is a vegetarians review.
They have an expansive vegetarian menu, which is tasty, healthy and light on the pocket.I tried the paneer wrap, which is a meal in and of itself. It is filling and tasty and oh so healthy!I particularly loved their salads. Extremely healthy option of great fresh vegetables with just the right amount of dressing and such a huge portion. This would be an ideal office lunch option. My friend ordered the dal makhni meal and the subz hand. I think the pictures speak for themselves here. Although, to be honest, the a la carte menu is outshone by the box meal option. The flavoured rice and the dal makhni had such a wonderful homely taste! 
I think, all in all, the place is an ideal option for a healthy meal with great VFM. Their two for one offer is insane! Im surprised the place hasnt been reviewed more.

(I was given a free sampling of the food, but this did not affect my review in any way)
